## About
Riley's Repair and Refuel is an auto repair shop, fueling station, and convenience store serving Overland Park and the surrounding communities. George Riley started it, passed it down to his son, and today it's run by long time family friends, The Walden Family.
Likely you're here because your tires don't feel right, it's time for an oil change, or you want a friendly, honest mechanic to check out a noise or smell coming from your car. Every business claims to be the best. We'd rather let our work and loyal customers speak for us.
We're rated 4.3 from 159 Google reviews. One customer says the crew is "the old school kind of respectful" and reminds her of a small town shop and gas station. Another thanks Anthony for communicating well at every step.

## Services
- A/C Repair: Cold air back in your car before the Kansas summer gets going.
- Starting, Charging and Batteries: When the car won't turn over, we'll check the battery and charging system.
- Engine Diagnostics and Performance: That little check engine light turned on? Bring it by and we'll find out why.
- Transmission Repair: Transmission work done by our team on Metcalf Ln.
- Oil Changes: When it's time to get your oil changed, we'll take care of it.
- Brake Repair: Brake work to keep you stopping the way you should.
- Steering and Suspension: One customer brought in a steering issue and says the team was very thorough in getting to the root cause.
- Preventive Maintenance: Regular care to keep your vehicle rolling.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Thursday 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM, Friday 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM, and Saturday 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM. We're closed Sunday.

Q: Do you sell tires?
A: Yes. Browse our tire catalog and choose from our broad selection of car, truck and SUV tires.

Q: Can I wait while my car is worked on?
A: Yes, we have a waiting room. One reviewer says she felt comfortable waiting at the shop on her phone, and there's a little bench area outside if it's nice out.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes. Financing with the NAPA EasyPay Credit Card also extends the standard warranty to 36 months/36,000 miles.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We're proud to serve Overland Park, KS, Kansas City, MO, Olathe, KS, and surrounding areas.
